in_sanskrit.name: Ayanvin
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Divine Protector
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ayanvin एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ayanvin is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Ayan' meaning 'protector' and 'Vin' meaning 'divine'. This name is given to a boy symbolizing his role as a guardian, protector, and provider. In Hindu mythology, Ayanvin is a form of Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe.
